headline: AZB & Partners, S&R Associates, Hogan Lovells Cadwalader acts on Paras Hospitals ₹1,450 crore IPO
sum: Paras Healthcare Limited has raised ₹1,450 crore from an initial public offering of equity shares which comprised a fresh issue and an offer for sale by selling shareholders. AZB & Partners advised Paras Hospitals on this IPO.
detail: Paras Healthcare Limited has raised ₹1,450 crore from an initial public offering of equity shares which comprised a fresh issue and an offer for sale by selling shareholders. AZB & Partners advised Paras Hospitals on this IPO. The transaction was led by Agnik Bhattacharyya (Senior Partner) and Sweta Ananthanarayanan (Partner), with support from Tanaiy Tewari (Senior Associate). S&R Associates served as the Indian legal counsel for the book running lead managers JM Financial Limited, BOFA Securities India Limited, and Nuvama Wealth Management Limited, on this IPO.
